name: Amaspace
author: Amaspace

sections.description:
🌐 Live demo store: https://wordpress.amaspace.co/

Amaspace makes it easy to embed interactive 3D product configurators in your WooCommerce or WordPress website — without writing a single line of code.

With this plugin, users can:
– Customize product colors, textures, materials, and price-based options
– View the product live in 3D, with real-time interaction
– Preview the product in Augmented Reality (AR) or Try-On mode
– Add the configured product directly to the WooCommerce cart
– Let the plugin automatically calculate prices and product variants
– See the complete order in the WordPress admin after checkout
– Reuse the same configurator across multiple sites (multi-store ready)

Who it’s for:
– Manufacturers offering product customization
– Print-on-demand businesses using services
– Online retailers selling modular or personalized products
– Agencies managing multiple eCommerce stores

Amaspace is managed through your Amaspace dashboard, where you set up your configurators and rules. The plugin handles the frontend experience and WooCommerce integration.

Features

  • 🧩 No-code 3D configurator embedded via shortcode or Gutenberg block
  • 🎨 Customizable options: color, texture, price, rules, annotations
  • 📱 Mobile support with AR and Try-On viewing
  • 🛒 Seamless WooCommerce integration with price calculation and checkout
  • 🔁 Multi-store support (use the same configurator across many domains)
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen or upload it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Amaspace → Settings in your admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your API Key from the Amaspace dashboard.
  5. Use [amaspace id="your-configurator-id"] in any page or post, or use the Amaspace Gutenberg block.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Amaspace account?

Yes. You’ll need an account to create and manage your 3D configurators. A free trial is available.

Can I use the same configurator across multiple stores and platforms (e.g., WordPress and Shopify)?

Yes. Amaspace is platform-independent — you can embed the same configurator on different websites, including WordPress, Shopify, or any CMS that supports HTML/JavaScript.

Does Amaspace work with page builders like Elementor?

Yes. You can insert the configurator into any page using shortcodes, including inside Elementor widgets or other popular page builders.

Can I see what configuration the customer selected?

Yes. All customer choices are saved with the WooCommerce order and displayed in the WordPress admin.

Is it possible to test without a subscription?

Yes. You can start with a free trial and test the full plugin integration before upgrading your plan.
